okada1985_table2.conventions: Right-handed x,y,z; elastic medium occupies z<=0, free surface z=0, z positive UP; x parallel to fault strike. All Table 2 points are on the free surface (z=0). Finite fault: occupies xi' in [0,L] along strike, eta' in [0,W] measured UP-DIP from the reference edge; fault point (xi',eta') sits at (xi', eta'*cos(dip), -d + eta'*sin(dip)). So d is the depth of the eta'=0 edge (the BOTTOM/deep edge when sin(dip)>0) and its corner (0,0,-d) is the origin. Point source (case 1) sits at (0,0,-d). U1,U2,U3 = strike-slip, dip-slip, tensile: motion of hanging wall relative to footwall; for 0<dip<90 positive U1 is left-lateral, positive U2 is reverse (thrust), positive U3 is opening. Medium lambda=mu (Poisson ratio 0.25; DC3D alpha=(lambda+mu)/(lambda+2mu)=2/3). Units: case 1 in units of U*dSigma (potency), cases 2-4 in units of U; lengths dimensionless. Printed precision 4 significant figures; zeros are exact (symmetry) zeros. Derivatives are raw d(u_i)/d(x_j) in this frame (no strain sign flips).

okada1992_table2.status: NO NUMERICAL CHECK TABLE EXISTS IN OKADA (1992). Its Table 2 is the closed-form expression table for point-source internal displacement (Tables 2-9 are all formula tables); the 'Numerical results' section (p.1037) contains only figures. The only Okada-authored DC3D check value is in the NIED DC3D user manual, Appendix-2, given below (displacements only, no derivatives).
okada1992_table2.citation: Okada, Y. (1992). Internal deformation due to shear and tensile faults in a half-space. BSSA 82(2), 1018-1040. doi:10.1785/BSSA0820021018; NIED 'Manual for subroutines DC3D0 and DC3D' (Apr. 16, 2012), Appendix-2 'Test routine to check displacement calculation by DC3D'.
source: https://www.bosai.go.jp/e/pdf/Okada_1992_BSSA.pdf  (paper; confirms Table 2 is formulas, no checklist)

okada1992_table2.conventions: DC3D(ALPHA, X,Y,Z, DEPTH, DIP, AL1,AL2, AW1,AW2, DISL1,DISL2,DISL3) -> UX,UY,UZ, UXX,UYX,UZX, UXY,UYY,UZY, UXZ,UYZ,UZZ, IRET. Same frame as Okada (1985): medium z<=0 (Z must be <=0, else IRET=2), x along strike. Fault reference point (origin) at (0,0,-DEPTH); fault spans strike coordinate [AL1,AL2] and UP-DIP coordinate [AW1,AW2] from that origin, i.e. fault point (xi,eta) is at (xi, eta*cos(DIP), -DEPTH + eta*sin(DIP)). ALPHA=(lambda+mu)/(lambda+2mu) (=2/3 for lambda=mu, nu=0.25). For 0<DIP<90: +DISL1 left-lateral, +DISL2 reverse, +DISL3 opening. UXY means d(UX)/dy (first index = displacement component, second = derivative direction). Units: U* in unit of DISL; derivatives in DISL / length unit. Okada's interface is REAL*4 (single precision) for inputs and outputs; internal math is REAL*8.

cases.name: dc3d_manual_appendix2
cases.notes: Displacements only (manual prints no derivative answers). Printed to 4 decimals from a REAL*4 run; suggested tolerance ~1e-4 absolute (relative ~3e-6). Expected IRET=0.

okada1992_table2.surface_bridge_note: Okada (1985) Table 2 cases 1-4 are the z=0 special case of DC3D0/DC3D: see 'dc3d_equivalent_call' on each okada1985_table2 case (DC3D with AL1=0, AL2=L, AW1=0, AW2=W, DEPTH=d, Z=0, ALPHA=2/3; DC3D0 with POT_i=U_i*dSigma=1). This mapping follows from the shared geometry definitions; it is NOT itself printed by Okada. DC3D also returns z-derivatives (UXZ,UYZ,UZZ) for which no published check values exist.
